item.title: High Protein Dinner Ideas: 5 Easy Recipes Ready in 30 Minutes
item.description: High protein dinner ideas you can make in about 30 minutes. Five simple recipes: sheet pan chicken, a turkey taco skillet, salmon rice bowls, egg fried rice and a white bean soup. Each comes with an easy swap. Guide contains affiliate links.
